_doc: Street birds (src/client/life.ts, view only, never in the sim): pigeons pecking round the spawn spots, and in the city (world sf) seagulls at the bay edge, the piers and EMB. pigeons: flocks (at most this many, every few spawn spots), perFlock birds each, spread metres across, ahead metres in front of the spot; a bird scatters when a skater comes within scatter + scatterPerSpeed x speed (m/s) metres. gulls: areas are [x, y] centres with a radius r (metres) and n birds dropped on flat open ground there (edge: only where the bay is within edgeDist metres, a sample that far out finding no ground); roofs are rooftops they stand along (a box: centre, long axis, length and width in metres, the roof's height z), n birds spread along both long edges, inset metres in; ledges are single perches [x, y, z]; lamps: up to max birds on the street lights within r metres of each near centre [x, y, r], lift metres above the lamp head. Gulls scatter at scatter + scatterPerSpeed x speed metres (a perched one only when you come up level with it, within perchReach metres below), fly for flight seconds [min, max] circling (turn radians a second) at speed m/s, then glide back; size scales the bird; cry: the chance a flock that scatters cries (Settings > Audio > Crowd and ambience), heard to cryFar metres.
